'''Gaerboud IV''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]],<ref name="Email" /> a part of the [[Sepan sector/Legends|Sepan sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Gaerboud IV was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] [[Sentinel (Deep Space Manufacturing Facility)|Sentinel]] which manufactured [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Dauntless (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Dauntless'']] traveled to Gaerboud IV to receive a complement of TIE Avengers from the [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Battle of Gaerboud IV|sent]] a strike force to interrupt the transfer and destroy the new [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="XWvTF" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gaerboud IV first appeared in the [[1997]] PC [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]''.<ref name="XWvTF" /> 

[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[April]] [[2023]] that Gaerboud IV originally was a misspelling of [[Gerbaud 2]], and confirmed that Gaerboud IV was located in the Sepan system.<ref name="Email" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'' {{1st}}
